day_shape: 46 items: IRGC Navy claims two tankers struck mines in Strait of Hormuz/Oman Sea, WSJ reports Iran supplying Houthi targeting intel for Saudi strikes, Sisi tells parliament Egypt ready to defend Riyadh, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Tanker incidents near Strait of Hormuz
threads.summary: Iran's IRGC Navy claimed two oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines while crossing the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday, with Defa Press reporting a further non-compliant tanker ablaze in the Oman Sea. UK Maritime Trade Operations separately reported a small boat firing on an LNG tanker 140 nautical miles south-east of Mukalla, Yemen.

threads.label: Houthi-Saudi escalation and Egyptian pledge
threads.summary: The Wall Street Journal, cited by Iran International and Jerusalem Post, reported Iran is providing targeting intelligence enabling Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. Defa Press and Jerusalem Post reported Egyptian President Sisi told a military graduation ceremony he would seek parliamentary approval to defend Saudi Arabia if asked.

threads.label: Araghchi regional diplomacy at OIC
threads.summary: IRIB reported Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi held bilateral meetings with his Turkish and Lebanese counterparts on the sidelines of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation ministerial. Defa Press quoted Araghchi telling the OIC council that "one cannot build security at the expense of others' insecurity".

threads.label: IDF Gaza strikes and West Bank incident
threads.summary: The IDF announced four Hamas operatives were killed in recent Gaza strikes, including Nukhba Force member Mahmoud Khaled Mohammed Madhoun identified as having participated in the October 7 attack. The IDF separately condemned violence by Israeli rioters against diplomatic representatives in the Taybeh area, with police and forensic investigators deployed.

threads.label: Proposed defence minister's consultations
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB reported Iran's proposed Defence Minister Mehrdad Akhlaki met Law Enforcement Commander Radan and the head of the Basij Mostazafin Organisation. Discussions covered cooperation between the Defence Ministry and Faraja, and strengthening domestic defence-industrial capacities.

events.title_en: Al-Sudani: Iraq will never abandon support for Palestine
events.summary_en: Al-Sudani: Iraq will never abandon support for Palestine. Ali Falah al-Sudani, Prime Minister of Iraq, met today with Varsen Aghabekyan, Foreign Minister of the Palestinian Authority. Al-Sudani emphasised at this meeting that Palestine is not merely a slogan to chant, but rather an identity and a principled position that Iraq will never relinquish. He also stressed Iraq's continued support for Palestine, stating that this support will continue with the aim of achieving a just and comprehensive solution in which the Palestinian people obtain all their rights in their historic homeland.

events.title_en: New Saudi crime in Taiz, Yemen with 25 martyrs and wounded
events.summary_en: Almassirah news network reported that Saudi fighter jets bombed civilian homes Saturday evening in the Azla Hameer area of Taiz province. Saudi fighter jets bombed the area four times, and according to initial reports, 9 civilians including women and children were killed and 16 people were severely wounded. Local sources reported that a large number of civilians remain trapped under debris and rescue operations are extremely difficult.

events.title_en: Maritime incident off Yemen coast
events.summary_en: UK Maritime Trade Operations reported receiving reports of a maritime incident at 140 nautical miles south-east of Mukalla in Yemen. The captain of a liquefied natural gas (LNG) tanker reported that a small boat with 7 occupants approached the vessel. The occupants of the boat fired 2 rounds at the tanker, after which the armed security team positioned on the tanker also fired 2 warning shots towards the said boat; an action that caused the boat to change course.

events.title_en: Al-Sisi seeks Egyptian parliament's approval for military intervention on behalf of Saudi Arabia
events.summary_en: Egypt's President at the graduation ceremony of this country's military academy students said: Egypt is ready to take any action to protect and defend them based on the instructions of King Salman bin Abdulaziz and Crown Prince Mohammad bin Salman of Saudi Arabia. The necessary measures to protect and defend Saudi Arabia require parliamentary approval and I hope that this parliament in an emergency session will give us this permission. events.title_en: Ayatollah Sayed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Revolution, in a message congratulating the Iranian under-23 freestyle wrestling team's championship at the world championships...
events.summary_en: Ayatollah Sayed Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei, Supreme Leader of the Revolution, in a message congratulating the Iranian under-23 freestyle wrestling team's championship at the world championships, emphasised: My good wishes accompany all honourable youth of Iran along their path. The Supreme Leader's message is as follows: In the name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful. I congratulate the championship of Iran's under-23 freestyle wrestling team at the international world youth championships in America to these honourable champions, dedicated coaches and the people of Iran. The brilliance of the nation's youth, the stirring flutter of Iran's glorious flag and the resonance of the Islamic Republic's national anthem in various arenas, reflect the gleam of the nation's hopes in its youth in the path of achieving a glorious and magnificent future...

events.title: Iran's January crackdown: Snipers at Friday prayer leader's office, dorm
events.summary: Iran's security forces deployed snipers on the rooftops of the provincial Friday prayer leader's office and a women's student dormitory to fire on protesters during January's deadly crackdown in Semnan, east of Tehran, an Iran International investigation found.

events.title_en: Fostered in the school of creation's finest
events.summary_en: The fifth of Jumada al-Awwal commemorates the blessed birth of a lady who grew under the affection, education and companionship of the Five Purified Ones, peace be upon them, who are counted among the finest of God's creation. Zainab the Great's, peace be upon her, upbringing in this luminous school displayed a variegated manifestation of elements of nobility and excellence in this radiant star through the ages.

events.title: US CENTCOM chief Adm. Brad Cooper says Iran-backed militias are funneling money back to the IRGC as economic pressure mounts. Cooper also…
events.summary:
US CENTCOM chief Adm. Brad Cooper says Iran-backed militias are funneling money back to the IRGC as economic pressure mounts. Cooper also said militias, including Hezbollah and Hamas, are withholding payment to their own fighters to financially support the IRGC.

events.title: Iran giving Houthis targeting intelligence for Saudi attacks - WSJ
events.summary: Iranian support has helped Yemen’s Houthis carry out their most potent and sophisticated attacks yet on Saudi Arabia and its Yemeni allies, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing people briefed on intelligence from Saudi Arabia and Yemen’s anti-Houthi alliance.
